note: Sports and leisure equipment a posed figure can hold, carry, ride or stand beside. Every item is one object (a single dumbbell, a single skate) because the front template asks for a single object; balls and rackets float, board-like and wheeled things stand. All surfaces are plain: no crests, sponsor marks, size stencils or printed graphics.
